rows.sql:
SELECT h.name, h.born_state, h.age
FROM head h
JOIN management m ON h.head_ID = m.head_ID
JOIN department d ON m.department_ID = d.Department_ID
ORDER BY h.age;

SELECT d."Creation", d."Name", d."Budget_in_Billions"
FROM "department" d;
SELECT MAX(Budget_in_Billions) AS Max_Budget, MIN(Budget_in_Billions) AS Min_Budget FROM department;

SELECT DISTINCT "Creation" 
FROM "department" 
WHERE "Department_ID" IN (
    SELECT "department_ID" 
    FROM "management" 
    WHERE "head_ID" IN (
        SELECT "head_ID" 
        FROM "head" 
        WHERE "born_state" = 'Alabama'
    )
);

SELECT DISTINCT "born_state"
FROM head
GROUP BY "born_state"
HAVING COUNT("head_ID") >= 3;

SELECT "Creation" AS Year, COUNT(*) AS Count
FROM "department"
GROUP BY "Creation"
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT d.Name, m.Num_Employees
FROM department d
JOIN management m ON d.Department_ID = m.department_ID
WHERE m.temporary_acting = 'yes';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM management;

SELECT DISTINCT "born_state"
FROM head
WHERE head_ID IN (
    SELECT "head_ID" FROM management
    WHERE Department_ID IN (
        SELECT "Department_ID" FROM department
        WHERE Name = 'Department'
    )
    AND temporary_acting = 'Secretary of Treasury'
)
AND head_ID IN (
    SELECT "head_ID" FROM management
    WHERE Department_ID IN (
        SELECT "Department_ID" FROM department
        WHERE Name = 'Security'
    )
    AND temporary_acting = 'Secretary of Homeland Security'
);

SELECT d.Department_ID, d.Name, COUNT(m.head_ID) AS Num_Heads
FROM department d
JOIN management m ON d.Department_ID = m.department_ID
GROUP BY d.Department_ID
HAVING COUNT(m.head_ID) > 1;

SELECT m.head_ID, h.name
FROM management m
JOIN head h ON m.head_ID = h.head_ID
WHERE h.name LIKE '%ha%';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM farm;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM farm;

SELECT MAX(Total_Cattle) AS Max_Cows, MIN(Total_Cattle) AS Min_Cows
FROM farm;

SELECT MAX(Total_Cattle) AS Max_Cows, MIN(Total_Cattle) AS Min_Cows
FROM farm;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Status) FROM city;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Status) FROM city;

SELECT Official_Name, Status
FROM city
WHERE City_ID IN (
    SELECT City_ID
    FROM city
    ORDER BY Population DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT Official_Name, Status
FROM city
WHERE City_ID IN (
    SELECT City_ID
    FROM city
    ORDER BY Population DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT f."Official_Name", f."Year"
FROM "farm_competition" fc
JOIN "city" c ON fc."Host_city_ID" = c."City_ID"

SELECT Official_Name
FROM city
WHERE City_ID IN (
    SELECT Host_city_ID
    FROM farm_competition
    GROUP BY Host_city_ID
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
);

SELECT c."Official_Name"
FROM "city" c
WHERE c."City_ID" IN (
    SELECT fc."Host_city_ID"
    FROM "farm_competition" fc
    GROUP BY fc."Host_city_ID"
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
);

SELECT c.Status
FROM city c
WHERE c.City_ID IN (
    SELECT f.Host_city_ID
    FROM farm_competition f
    GROUP BY f.Host_city_ID
    ORDER BY COUNT(f.Competition_ID) DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT Status
FROM city
WHERE City_ID IN (
    SELECT Host_city_ID
    FROM farm_competition
    GROUP BY Host_city_ID
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT fc.Theme
FROM farm_competition fc
JOIN city c ON fc.Host_city_ID = c.City_ID
WHERE c.Official_Name IN (SELECT Official_Name FROM city WHERE Area_km_2 > 1000);

SELECT DISTINCT "Theme"
FROM "competition_record"
JOIN "farm_competition" ON "competition_record"."Competition_ID" = "farm_competition"."Competition_ID"
JOIN "city" ON "farm_competition"."Host_city_ID" = "city"."City_ID"
WHERE "city"."Population" > 1000;

SELECT c.Status, AVG(f.Population) AS Average_Population
FROM city c
JOIN farm f ON c.City_ID = f.Farm_ID
GROUP BY c.City_ID;

SELECT Status, COUNT(*) as Count
FROM city
GROUP BY Status
ORDER BY Count;

SELECT Status, COUNT(Status) AS Frequency
FROM city
GROUP BY Status
ORDER BY Frequency ASC;

SELECT Status, COUNT(*) as Count
FROM city
GROUP BY Status
ORDER BY Count DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT Status, COUNT(*) as Count
FROM city
GROUP BY Status
ORDER BY Count DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT Status
FROM city
WHERE Population > 1500
UNION
SELECT Status
FROM city
WHERE Population < 500;
SELECT "Census_Ranking" FROM "city" WHERE "Status" != 'village';

SELECT c.course_id, COUNT(sc.course_id) as num_students
FROM Student_Course_Registrations sc
JOIN Student_Course_Attendance sca ON sc.student_id = sca.student_id AND sc.course_id = sca.course_id
JOIN Courses c ON sc.course_id = c.course_id
GROUP BY c.course_id
ORDER BY num_students DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT C.course_name
FROM Courses C
JOIN Student_Course_Registrations SC ON C.course_id = SC.course_id
GROUP BY C.course_id
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.student_id, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.course_id) AS num_courses
FROM Students s
JOIN Student_Course_Registrations sc ON s.student_id = sc.student_id
GROUP BY s.student_id
ORDER BY num_courses ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT student_id
FROM Student_Course_Attendance
GROUP BY student_id
ORDER BY COUNT(course_id) ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT first_name, last_name FROM People WHERE person_id IN (SELECT person_id FROM People_Addresses WHERE person_id IN (SELECT person_id FROM Candidates WHERE candidate_id IN (SELECT candidate_id FROM Candidate_Assessments))));

SELECT first_name, last_name FROM People WHERE person_id IN (SELECT person_id FROM People_Addresses WHERE person_id IN (SELECT person_id FROM Candidates WHERE candidate_id IN (SELECT candidate_id FROM Candidate_Assessments))));

SELECT s.student_id
FROM Students s
WHERE s.student_id NOT IN (
    SELECT scr.student_id
    FROM Student_Course_Attendance scr
    GROUP BY scr.student_id
    HAVING COUNT(scr.student_id) = 0
);

SELECT Student_Course_Registrations.student_id
FROM Student_Course_Registrations
SELECT student_id FROM Student_Course_Attendance GROUP BY student_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 0;

SELECT s.student_id, c.course_name
FROM Students s
JOIN Student_Course_Registrations sc ON s.student_id = sc.student_id
JOIN Student_Course_Attendance sac ON sc.student_id = sac.student_id AND sc.course_id = sac.course_id
JOIN Courses c ON sc.course_id = c.course_id;

SELECT s.student_details
FROM Students s
JOIN Student_Course_Registrations scr ON s.student_id = scr.student_id
JOIN Student_Course_Attendance scaa ON scr.student_id = scaa.student_id AND scr.course_id = scaa.course_id
JOIN Course c ON scr.course_id = c.course_id
WHERE scaa.date_of_attendance = (SELECT MAX(date_of_attendance) FROM Student_Course_Attendance)
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.student_id, s.student_details, scr.registration_date
FROM Students s
JOIN Student_Course_Registrations scr ON s.student_id = scr.student_id
ORDER BY scr.registration_date DESC;

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Student_Course_Attendance
WHERE course_id = (SELECT course_id FROM Courses WHERE course_name = 'English');

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_students_attending_english_courses
FROM Student_Course_Attendance
JOIN Student_Course_Registrations ON Student_Course_Attendance.student_id = Student_Course_Registrations.student_id
JOIN Courses ON Student_Course_Registrations.course_id = Courses.course_id
WHERE Courses.course_name = 'English';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Student_Course_Attendance WHERE student_id = 171;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Student_Course_Attendance WHERE student_id = 171;

SELECT Candidate_Assessments.assessment_outcome_code
FROM Candidate_Assessments
WHERE Candidate_Assessments.candidate_id IN (
    SELECT Candidates.candidate_id
    FROM Candidates
    WHERE Candidates.email_address = 'stanley.monahan at example.org'
);

SELECT Candidate_Assessments.candidate_id
FROM Candidate_Assessments
JOIN Candidates ON Candidate_Assessments.candidate_id = Candidates.candidate_id
JOIN People ON Candidates.person_id = People.person_id
WHERE People.email_address = 'stanley.monahan at example.org';

SELECT Candidate_Assessments.candidate_id
FROM Candidate_Assessments
JOIN Student_Course_Attendance ON Candidate_Assessments.candidate_id = Student_Course_Attendance.student_id
JOIN Student_Course_Registrations ON Student_Course_Attendance.student_id = Student_Course_Registrations.student_id
JOIN Courses ON Student_Course_Attendance.course_id = Courses.course_id
WHERE Student_Course_Attendance.date_of_attendance = (
    SELECT MAX(date_of_attendance)
    FROM Student_Course_Attendance
    WHERE student_id = Candidate_Assessments.candidate_id
)
ORDER BY Candidate_Assessments.candidate_id
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.student_details
FROM Students s
WHERE s.student_id IN (
    SELECT scr.student_id
    FROM Student_Course_Registrations scr
    GROUP BY scr.student_id
    ORDER BY COUNT(scr.course_id) DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT S.student_id, S.student_details, COUNT(SCR.course_id) as num_courses
FROM Students S
JOIN Student_Course_Registrations SCR ON S.student_id = SCR.student_id
GROUP BY S.student_id
ORDER BY num_courses DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.student_id, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.course_id) as num_courses
FROM Students s
JOIN Student_Course_Registrations sc ON s.student_id = sc.student_id
GROUP BY s.student_id;

SELECT Courses.course_name AS course_name, COUNT(Student_Course_Registrations.student_id) AS num_students
FROM Student_Course_Registrations
JOIN Student_Course_Attendance ON Student_Course_Registrations.student_id = Student_Course_Attendance.student_id
JOIN Courses ON Student_Course_Registrations.course_id = Courses.course_id
GROUP BY Courses.course_name;

SELECT c.course_id, COUNT(sc.course_id) AS num_students, c.course_name
FROM Courses c
JOIN Student_Course_Registrations sc ON c.course_id = sc.course_id
GROUP BY c.course_id;
SELECT candidate_id FROM Candidate_Assessments WHERE assessment_outcome_code = 'pass';

SELECT p.cell_mobile_number
FROM Candidates p
JOIN Candidate_Assessments ca ON p.candidate_id = ca.candidate_id
WHERE ca.assessment_outcome_code = 'fail';

SELECT p.cell_mobile_number

SELECT s.student_id
FROM Students s
WHERE s.student_id IN (
    SELECT scr.student_id
    FROM Student_Course_Registrations scr
    WHERE scr.course_id = 301
    ORDER BY scr.registration_date DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT student_id
FROM Student_Course_Registrations
WHERE course_id = 301
ORDER BY date_of_attendance DESC

SELECT DISTINCT city FROM Addresses;

SELECT first_name FROM People ORDER BY first_name;
